svg.text: bias_tree_pd: mirror tree + the four bias diodes BP, BPC, BN, BNC (bias_diodes); vabp / vabn are current outputs
Cut from macros/bias_in_pd (the flat sheet) without its inverter IP / IN; en_3v3_b is a port here.
TGN / TGP pass iref to ni while enabled; TDN pulls ni to vss while disabled. Source: bias_ref_pd.spice
[E] enable (en_3v3: 0 ... 3.3 V on vdd / vss, active high): IP / IN make en_3v3_b. Enabled, the transmission gate TGN / TGP

NABP sinks 5 uA from vabp, PABN sources 5 uA into vabn. Their diode stacks RP2 + RP1 / RN2 + RN1 sit in the pad: RP2 / RN2 in d2s_mpdda_pd next to ABP / ABN (2026-10-27), RP1 / RN1 in the clamp frames d2s_out_p / d2s_out_n next to OP / ON (2026-10-28).
[DT] layout dummies of the tree rows (C2 backannotation): MDBP 2u/6u D = S = B = vdd, G = vbp; MDBN 2.4u/6u D = S = G = ni, B = vss
